rationale: Price is at 92.9% of today's wide range ($18.50–$23.34) and sitting near the session high after a massive intraday move, but the last five 1-minute candles show deteriorating momentum — volume collapsed from 64K to under 2K before a partial bounce, and the bid-ask spread of 87 bps reflects thin liquidity at these elevated levels. With SPY down ~1% and VIXY up 5.2% adding macro headwind, and price already extended well above VWAP ($21.12) and the 9-EMA ($22.60), the risk/reward for chasing long is poor while a short entry here lacks a clean technical trigger with price still near the high; skipping is the prudent choice.
